hook: Every red-blue coloring of the plane with no red unit-distance pair contains a blue line of seven points.
hook_turn: contains a blue line of seven points.
summary: The authors improve the known unavoidable line from five points to seven, where consecutive points are one unit apart. They also prove results for three-colorings, higher dimensions and other shapes such as a regular pentagon. The proofs combine averaging inequalities, Fourier and linear-programming methods, and a measure theorem from OpenAI's Hadwiger-Nelson work. Longer lines are still unresolved.
title: Euclidean Ramsey Theory for Lines and Finite Configurations
